description: Publish a ready-made video file directly to social accounts — no generation, no schedule. Reads a local video (.mp4 or .mov, max 2GB) and posts it immediately via POST /api/upload-content. YouTube requires title, description, tags, and privacyStatus; Instagram/Bluesky/LinkedIn/Threads require caption.

accountIds.description: Target accounts: the IDs from list_social_accounts (channel IDs for YouTube, IG user IDs for Instagram, DIDs for Bluesky, member IDs or org URNs for LinkedIn, user IDs for Threads).

provider.description: The social platform to publish the video to.

tags.description: YouTube only: required list of tags.

videoPath.description: Local path to the video file (.mp4 or .mov, max 2GB). The video is published as-is: no generation, no schedule.

name: publish_video_direct
